paragraphs.text: Plink is a Witherbloom student at Strixhaven on Arcavios .

Plink has a quirky and animated demeanor, often showing excitement and nervousness in different situations. She has disheveled attire, suggesting a casual and carefree attitude towards her appearance.

Amid the chaos and danger brought by the Oriq invasion, Plink, alongside her friends Rowan Kenrith and Auvernine , faced the imminent threat with fear and determination. Despite her initial anxiety, Plink showed bravery when confronting the invading creatures, participating actively in the defensive efforts with her magical abilities.

Throughout the ordeal, Plink's loyalty to her friends and her determination to survive were evident. She played a crucial role alongside Rowan and Auvernine, displaying resourcefulness and courage under pressure as they fought to defend themselves and escape the encroaching danger on the Strixhaven campus.
